objectives: Ask for the guarantee before selecting a mechanism.
Use actual traces to defend failure and recovery behavior.

sections.title: Candidate brief
sections.markdown: An order API commits SQL state and publishes an event to a broker. Customers report accepted orders missing from shipping; a recent retry change also caused duplicate shipment requests. Locate concrete failure windows and propose a reliable handoff. Do not assume a distributed transaction exists. Start by clarifying the required guarantees.

sections.title: Saved assessment workflow
sections.markdown: Use the interview center for45minutes of reasoning and15minutes of feedback. Ask one clarification at a time. Record actual statements and artifacts. Finish the answering phase before retrieving the separate reference/debrief. A rubric score is educational evidence, not a hiring prediction.
